title: The Quiet Art of Slow Mornings
author: Maya Torres
body:
There is a particular kind of quiet that only exists before the rest of the world wakes up. It is in that quiet that the tone for the day gets set, long before the first email or the first obligation arrives.

The habit isn't about waking up earlier for its own sake. It's about protecting a stretch of time where nothing is being asked of you yet, so you can decide what you want from the day instead of reacting to what the day wants from you.

Start small: ten minutes of no screens. It compounds faster than you'd expect.
